MANIACAL is an independent journal for people who would rather inspect the machinery than applaud the demo. We write about technology as a human project: full of ambition, accidents, incentives, and very weird edge cases.

No trend reports. No content sludge. Just durable ideas, specific observations, and the occasional beautiful provocation.
